name: Convex Query
description: Execute a read-only query against a Convex peer

peer.description: Convex peer endpoint (host:port, tcp:// or tls://). Omit it to use the venue's peer; another peer works only where the operator allows relaying.

source.description: Convex Lisp source code to query

errorCode.description: Error code, if an error occurred

result.description: Result of the query, as Convex printed data structure.

value.description: Result of the query, as JSON (some type distinctions may be lost).
